info.title: NEXORA AI API
info.description: Business operations & workflow intelligence platform. All tenant endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer` and `X-Org-Id`.

get.description: DPDP/GDPR-style data portability: everything NEXORA stores that is personal to this user.

post.description: Two-step deletion: owner confirms name + password; org is locked and data is purged after a 7-day grace period.
Lets analysts edit the generated SQL. The same guard applies to human-written SQL.
Convert meeting notes / conversations into tasks. With create=false returns suggestions for review (human in the loop).

get.description: Acquisition/activation/retention from the event stream (same SQL as database/analytics_views.sql).
